question: Who originally transmitted this teaching and to whom was it given?
premises: The teaching was told by Nārāyaṇa
It was told out of compassion
It was told to Brahmā in the past
inference: Nārāyaṇa formerly told this teaching out of compassion to Brahmā.
plain_english: It was formerly told out of compassion by Nārāyaṇa to Brahmā.
